blocker: The preserved frontend bundle defines only GET /api/v2/players/simboosts-use/:companyId/ for reading spend history. It has no POST callsite, request payload, response access, or action-to-domain transition for this path.
knownAtomicSpends: POST /api/v2/companies/buildings/:buildingId/rush/ uses the persisted rush-production use case and records action code c.
POST /api/v2/companies/buildings/:buildingId/construction-rush/ uses the persisted rush-construction use case and records action code c.
POST /api/v2/players/unlocked-hqs/ and POST /api/v2/players/unlocked-pas/ use persisted entitlement use cases and record action codes q and D.
decision: Do not add a permissive POST handler or debit based only on the action code table. Implement a new action only after an observed request payload, exact preconditions, and persisted state transition are available.
